_meta.title: Research corrections to staged census source workbooks
_meta.method: Manual verification against the printed 1851 census, volume II (printed pp. 118-135), cross-checked against workbook, staged SQLite and retrieval JSONL under recorded SHA-256 hashes. Full audit trail in research/1851_quebec_measurement_audit_20260907/ (verify.py reproduces byte-for-byte; adversarially reviewed).
_meta.policy: Source workbooks, staged SQLite and source RDF remain verbatim. These corrections are a documented research overlay surfaced on the published evidence pages and in the retrieval JSONL. Reassignments are applied only where the printed volume adjudicates; printed internal inconsistencies are annotated, never replaced.

row_notes.69: County row transposition: the statistical block F-BI in this row, labelled St. Maurice, contains the printed county totals of Saguenay. The printed St. Maurice totals sit in workbook row 70. Verified cell-by-cell against printed pp. 130-135; the CSD workbook's subdivision returns independently support the printed assignment. Each affected cell below carries a research_correction with the reassigned value.
row_notes.70: County row transposition: the statistical block F-BI in this row, labelled Saguenay, contains the printed county totals of St. Maurice. The printed Saguenay totals sit in workbook row 69. Verified cell-by-cell against printed pp. 130-135; the CSD workbook's subdivision returns independently support the printed assignment. Each affected cell below carries a research_correction with the reassigned value.
row_notes.66: Printed arithmetic discrepancy in Richelieu (OAT_XX_B): see the research correction on the affected cell. The workbook value matches the printed county total.
row_notes.68: Printed arithmetic discrepancy in Rouville (WHT_XX_B): see the research correction on the affected cell. The workbook value matches the printed county total.
